nodes.label: Arabic Linguistic Correctness
nodes.rationale: Over-normalization silently corrupts Arabic pronunciation and meaning.

nodes.label: Graceful Degradation
nodes.rationale: A multi-provider system should survive a single vendor outage.

nodes.label: Latency Is a Feature
nodes.rationale: Perceived latency determines whether a conversational avatar feels real-time.

nodes.label: Measured, Not Claimed
nodes.rationale: Evaluation claims must be reproducible and falsifiable.

nodes.label: Provider Independence
nodes.rationale: Arabic TTS vendors differ in quality, cost, and dialect coverage and must remain replaceable.

nodes.label: Python-First Backend
nodes.rationale: The reusable value is the Python pipeline; frontend domain logic would need to be rewritten.

nodes.label: Secure by Default
nodes.rationale: Speech content and paid credentials are sensitive and irrecoverable after disclosure.

nodes.label: Testability and Simplicity
nodes.rationale: The prototype must stay legible and verifiable, and complexity must earn its place.
